title: Build a URL Safely
story: Never glue query strings by hand. Let the library escape them.
goal: Write build(base, params) that returns the URL with an encoded query string.
hints: urlencode turns a dict into a=1&b=2 and escapes special characters.
Join the base, a question mark and the encoded string.
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Build a URL Safely”?
